script.text: Syrus and Jaden watched Syrus' brother, Zane, mercilessly defeat another pro duelist on TV.
Sigh. My brother just hasn't been himself, and I can't stand to see him like this.
He does seem to be angrier these days. But I think the whole "bad guy" thing is just an act. Ever since Zane changed his image, he's gotten way more popular.
I guess. But it's still hard to watch.
After his duel, Zane received a letter that read: "Truesdale. Meet me at the top of the world." Zane climbed a tall mountain to a secluded dojo where a familiar face waited for him.
Hello, Master. I should've known I'd find you here. I hope you didn't call me here to lecture me because I don't have time for nonsense.
You know why I called you here, Truesdale.
Are you sure you want to go through with this?
Of course! Now get our game on! Uh, you kids are still using that phrase, right?
You must realize I can play a card you know all too well. My Cyber End Dragon!
I'm well aware of your dragon's power, Truesdale. I'm the one who gave it to you, remember? Well, allow me to remind you about the way it was.
You are the one and only heir to an ancient birthright called "The Cyber Legacy." I was proud of the duelist you became, and I never regretted handing you that card. That is... until now.
This is sounding like a lecture, and I told you I don't have the time. I'm here for one reason and one reason only. To get what's coming to me! The rest of The Cyber Legacy!
Ah yes. There once existed a group of cards that came to be known as the "Deck of the Underworld." But it's been locked away... and with good reason. It contains a dangerous force.
Spare me the stories. I want those cards!
You have no choice. Once I defeat you, they're mine.
